duas.title: This is the first dua ever said by mankind. It was the dua of Prophet Adam A.S when he had committed his first mistake and turned to Allah SWT in repentance. This is a helpful dua to say for istighfar (seeking forgiveness).
duas.arabic_dua: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusana wa in lam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā lanakūnanna minal-khāsirīn.
duas.translation: “Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves. If You forgive us not, and bestow not upon us Your Mercy, we shall certainly be of the losers.” - (Quran 7:23)

duas.title: This is the dua that was said by Prophet Yunus A.S when he was stuck inside the belly of a whale. He felt hopeless and turned to Allah SWT in repentance, begging for His Mercy. Another wonderful dua to say for istighfar and at times of hardship.
duas.arabic_dua: لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā Anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.
duas.translation: “No one has the right to be worshiped but You (O Allah), Glorified (and Exalted) are You. Truly, I have been of the wrong-doers.” - (Qur'an 21:87)

duas.title: Prophet Ayub A.S was ill for many years with a terrible disease. He was known for his patience in enduring one calamity after another and remaining steadfast in his belief in Allah SWT. After a long time of suffering, he turned to his Lord asking for His Mercy with this dua.
duas.arabic_dua: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Annī massaniyaḍ-ḍurru wa Anta Arḥamur-Rāḥimīn.
duas.translation: “Verily, distress has seized me, and You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy.” - (Quran 21:83)

duas.title: 1. For Wisdom and Piety
duas.arabic_dua: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī ḥukman wa alḥiqnī biṣ-ṣāliḥīn, wa ajʿal lī lisāna ṣidqin fīl-ākhirīn, wa ajʿalnī miw-warathatil jannatin-naʿīm, wa lā tukhzinī yawma yubʿathūn, yawma lā yanfaʿu māluw-wa lā banūn, illā man atallāha biqalbin salīm.
duas.translation: “My Lord! Bestow judgment on me, and join me with the righteous; And grant me an honorable mention in later generations; And make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight; And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected; The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail, Except him who brings to Allah a clean heart.” - (Quran 26:83-89) *(Note: The Arabic text provided combines several verses.)*
duas.comment: The translation excludes the part about forgiveness for the father, which is included in the Arabic text of Quran 26:86.

duas.title: 2. For Asking Forgiveness
duas.arabic_dua: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanagh-fir lī wa liwālidayya wa lil-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmul-ḥisāb.
duas.translation: “Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will be established.” - (Quran 14:41)

duas.title: 3. For Placing His Trust In Allah
duas.arabic_dua: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ʿalayka tawakkalnā wa ilayka anabnā wa ilaykal-maṣīr.
duas.translation: “Our Lord! In You we put our trust, and to You we turn in repentance, and to You is (our) final return.” - (Quran 60:4)

duas.title: 1. For Good
duas.arabic_dua: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.
duas.translation: “My Lord! Truly, I am in need of whatever good that You bestow on me!” - (Quran 28:24)

duas.title: 2. For Good Speech
duas.arabic_dua: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi ashraḥ lī ṣadrī, wa yassir lī amrī, waḥlul ʿuqdatan mil-lisānī, yafqahū qawlī.
duas.translation: “O my Lord! Open for me my chest (grant me self-confidence, contentment, and boldness). And ease my task for me; And make loose the knot from my tongue, (i.e. remove the incorrectness from my speech). That they understand my speech.” - (Quran 20:25-28)

duas.title: For Allah SWT to make him die as a Muslim.
duas.arabic_dua: فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, Anta waliyyī fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah, tawaffanī Musliman wa alḥiqnī biṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
duas.translation: “The Creator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Walī (Protector, Helper, Supporter, Guardian, etc.) in this world and in the Hereafter, cause me to die as a Muslim (the one submitting to Your Will), and join me with the righteous.” - (Quran 12:101)

duas.title: For Allah’s SWT help in dealing with the evil people.
duas.arabic_dua: قَالَ رَبِّ انصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Qāla Rabbi anṣurnī ʿalal-qawmil-mufsidīn.
duas.translation: “My Lord, support me against the corrupting people.” - (Quran 29:30)

duas.title: He recited this dua for his dealings with his people.
duas.arabic_dua: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanāftaḥ baynanā wa bayna qawminā bil-ḥaqq, wa Anta khayrul-fātiḥīn.
duas.translation: “Our Lord! Judge between us and our people in truth, for You are the Best of those who give judgment.” - (Quran 7:89)

duas.title: For Forgiveness.
duas.arabic_dua: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innī aʿūdhu bika an as'alaka mā laysa lī bihī ʿilm, wa illā taghfir lī wa tarḥamnī akum minal-khāsirīn.
duas.translation: “O my Lord! I seek refuge with You from asking You that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy on me, I would indeed be one of the losers.” - (Quran 11:47)

duas.title: For Success in Both Worlds.
duas.arabic_dua: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī mil-ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibah, innaka Samīʿuḍ-ḍuʿā'
duas.translation: “O my Lord! Grant me from from You, a righteous offspring, You are indeed the All-Hearer of invocation.” - (Quran 3:38)

duas.title: 1. When he asked for relief...
duas.arabic_dua: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.transliteration: Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm! Bi raḥmatika astaghīth.
duas.translation: “O Living and Eternal Sustainer! By Your mercy I seek relief.”

duas.title: 2. A supplication he made frequently...
duas.arabic_dua: اللَّهُمَّ آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanah, wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanah, wa qinā ʿadhāban-nār.
duas.translation: “O Allah, grant us the good in this world and the good in the Hereafter and save us from the torment of Hell-Fire.” (Muslim)

duas.title: 3. He taught his companions to say this...
duas.arabic_dua: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-bukhli, wa aʿūdhu bika minal-jubn, wa aʿūdhu bika min an nuradda ilā ardhalil-ʿumuri, wa aʿūdhu bika min fitnatid-dunyā, wa ʿadhābil-qabr.
duas.translation: “O Allah! I seek refuge with You from miserliness, and seek refuge with You from cowardice, and seek refuge with You from being brought back to (senile) geriatric old age, and seek refuge with You from the affliction of the world and from the punishment in the Hereafter.” (Bukhari)

duas.title: 4. When he asked for guidance...
duas.arabic_dua: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-hudā wattuqā wal-ʿafāfa wal-ghinā.
duas.translation: “O Allah! Indeed I, I ask of You, guidance, piety and chastity and to be free of depending upon anyone (except You).” (Muslim)

duas.title: 5. When he asked for forgiveness...
duas.arabic_dua: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma-ghfir lī dhanbī kullah, diqqahu wa jillah, wa awwalahu wa ākhirah, wa ʿalāniyatahu wa sirrah.
duas.translation: “O Allah! Forgive all my sins, whether few or more, the first and the last, the apparent and the hidden.” (Muslim)

duas.title: 6. When he asked for obedience...
duas.arabic_dua: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.transliteration: Yā Muqallibal-qulūb, thabbit qalbī ʿalā dīnik.
duas.translation: “O Allah! The One Who turns the hearts, turn my heart towards Your obedience.” (Muslim)

duas.title: 7. When he asked for beneficial knowledge...
duas.arabic_dua: اَللّٰهُمَّ انْفَعْنِىْ بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِىْ وَ عَلِّمْنِىْ مَا يَنْفَعُنِىْ وَ زِدْنِىْ عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma anfaʿnī bimā ʿallamtanī wa ʿallimnī mā yanfaʿunī wa zidnī ʿilmā.
duas.translation: “O Allah! Benefit me through what You teach me and teach me what is beneficial for me and increase me in knowledge.” (Ibn Majah)

duas.title: 8. When he asked for Allah’s Mercy...
duas.arabic_dua: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min zawāli niʿmatik, wa taḥawwuli ʿāfiyatik, wa fujā'ati niqmatik, wa jamīʿi sakhaṭik.
duas.translation: O Allah! I seek refuge in You against the declining of Your Favors, the passing of safety, the suddenness of Your punishment, and all that which displeases You.

duas.title: 9. When he asked for success...
duas.arabic_dua: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَالسَّلاَمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ ، والغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ، والفَوْزَ بالجَنَّةِ، والنَّجَاةَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka mūjibāti raḥmatik, wa ʿazā'ima maghfiratik, was-salāmata min kulli ithm, wal-ghanīmata min kulli birr, wal-fawza bil-jannah, wan-najāta minan-nār.
duas.translation: O Allah! I beg You for that which incites Your Mercy and the means of Your forgiveness, safety from every sin, the benefit from every good deed, success in attaining Jannah, and deliverance from the Fire.

duas.title: 10. When he was in distress...
duas.arabic_dua: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhul-ʿAẓīmul-Ḥalīm, lā ilāha illallāhu Rabbul-ʿArshil-ʿAẓīm, lā ilāha illallāhu Rabbus-samāwāti wa Rabbul-Arḍi wa Rabbul-ʿArshil-Karīm.
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshiped but Allah, the Incomparably Great, the Compassionate. None has the right to be worshiped but Allah, the Lord of the Mighty Throne. None has the right to be worshiped but Allah, the Lord of the Heavens, the Lord of the Earth, and the Lord of the Honorable Throne.

duas.title: The Dua of Asiya (R.A), Pharaoh's wife, when she was being tortured...
duas.arabic_dua: رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbibni lī ʿindaka baytan fīl-jannah.
duas.translation: My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise. (Quran 66:11)

duas.title: The Dua of The People of the Cave when they were hiding...
duas.arabic_dua: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā mil-ladunka raḥmah, wa hayyi' lanā min amrinā rashadā.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Bestow on us mercy from Yourself, and facilitate for us our affair in the right way. (Quran 18:10)

duas.title: The Dua of The New Believers during Pharaoh's oppression...
duas.arabic_dua: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran wa tawaffanā Muslimīn.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Pour out on us patience, and cause us to die as Muslims. (Quran 7:126)

duas.title: The Dua of King Talut (Saul) for victory over Jalut (Goliath)...
duas.arabic_dua: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran wa thabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Pour forth on us patience and make us victorious over the disbelieving people. (Quran 2:250)
